what_they_do.text: Manappuram Finance Limited is India's second-largest gold loan NBFC, headquartered in Valapad, Thrissur, providing secured credit against pledged gold jewellery alongside diversified lending across microfinance, MSME and allied loans, vehicle finance, and affordable housing finance. In Q1 FY27, consolidated AUM reached INR 69,635 crores (with gold loans comprising 82% at INR 57,006 crores) and consolidated revenue from operations stood at INR 3,033 crores. Operating over 5,000 branches across India with its subsidiaries, the company leverages its Online Gold Loan (OGL) platform, which accounted for 86% of the gold loan book in Q1 FY27.

segments.name: Affordable Housing Finance (Manappuram Home Finance Limited)
Technology Support Services (Manappuram Comptech and Consultants Limited)

customers_and_markets.text: Manappuram Finance operates exclusively in India across 28 States and 6 Union Territories through 3,527 entity offices (over 5,000 branches consolidated), with zero international locations and 0% export contribution to turnover.
The company primarily targets rural, semi-urban, and Tier 2 to Tier 4 markets where formal banking penetration is relatively lower.

Key customer groups include retail individuals and gold jewellery holders (26.5 lakh outstanding gold loan customers in Q1 FY27), women from economically weaker households in microfinance, MSME entrepreneurs and small traders, and corporate and institutional clients.

recent_developments.text: Appointed Mr. Ashish Singh (formerly at IDFC First Bank) as MD and CEO, expected to join by January 1, 2027, to strengthen senior leadership.

Implemented revised RBI gold loan LTV and ticket-size guidelines effective April 1, 2026, launching monthly interest/EMI schemes and cash-flow-assessed income-generating gold loans at 14%-16% interest rates.

Subsidiary Asirvad Microfinance received a Corporate Agency (Insurance) Licence from IRDAI and expects to commence insurance distribution operations in FY 2026-27 alongside Tier-I city branch expansion for gold loans.
Scaled consolidated gold loan AUM by 98% YoY to INR 57,006 crores in Q1 FY27 while contracting vehicle finance AUM by 43% YoY to INR 2,562 crores to prioritize collections amid 13.3% GNPA.

bull.text: The company reported strong Q1 FY27 consolidated profit after tax of Rs 585 crore, representing a 45% growth quarter-on-quarter and 47% year-on-year {
The core gold loan business continues to show momentum with 12% quarter-on-quarter and 97% year-on-year AUM growth for the standalone entity in Q1 FY27 {
Regulatory removal of prior approval requirements allows the company to execute its plan to open 500 new branches in FY27 to drive further growth {

bear.text: The company missed the specific target for Asirvad MFI to turn profitable by Q4 FY26, as the entity only reported an incremental PAT improvement but faced significant historical volatility {
Vehicle finance asset quality remains a concern, with GNPA levels elevated at 13.3% in Q1 FY27, up from 10.4% in the prior quarter {
Standalone borrowing costs have experienced upward pressure, rising by 10 bps in the first quarter of FY27 amid elevated interest rate environments {
